summary: There is no modulus omega(r)->0 controlling one fixed positive-scale Gaussian heat maximum uniformly in the symmetric coefficient matrix over all admissible cap-one product laws, even when both matrices are full rank, have s3=1, and differ by operator norm r. The explicit pair is diag(1,1,1,delta^2) versus diag(1,1,1,delta^2+delta), with the common fourth marginal Uniform[delta^{-1},delta^{-1}+1]. The first output retains heat height >3/4 while the second is smoothed by an independent variable of density <1/2, so its heat height is <1/2. This refutes only a law-uniform near-null perturbation shortcut, not QFORM.
scope: fixed positive Gaussian heat scale; law-uniform coefficient perturbation over the exact target class
